thread:
alex.docs: heads-up: i pushed a docs PR updating samples for streaming, pagination, and retry semantics across py/ts/go. small changes but worth a quick review. link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4876
rachel-sdk: thanks — can you summarize user-visible changes? any breaking API changes?
alex.docs: no breaking changes. python: switch to a context-manager style for streams to make close semantics explicit. TS: return an AsyncIterator instead of callback events for easier backpressure handling. Go: fix resume token handling so we don't reuse buffers across pages. added tiny example tests.
ben-eng: paste the snippets and i'll run them locally.
alex.docs: sure, snippets below:
```py
# context-managed streaming (explicit close)
with client.streaming_chat(prompt) as stream:
    for ev in stream:
        if ev.type == 'message':
            print(ev.text)
```
```ts
// async-iterator style for streaming responses
for await (const msg of client.streamMessages(req)) {
  if (msg.kind === 'delta') console.log(msg.delta)
}
```
```go
// clone resume token per request to avoid shared buffer races
token := api.NewToken(resume)
for {
  resp, err := client.List(ctx, token)
  if err != nil { return err }
  token = resp.NextToken.Clone()
}
```
maya: tiny doc nit: let's add a link to the migration guide and call out common pitfalls (buffer reuse, idempotency assumptions for retries). happy to add a short paragraph.
rachel-sdk: CI is failing on one example: test_examples.py -> AttributeError: 'generator' object has no __enter__ — looks like one file still uses the old generator-without-context pattern.
alex.docs: missed that one, pushed a fix that updates the example to the context-manager form and removes the unused import. also fixed a stale link in streaming.md that referenced the old SDK repo. replaced with canonical docs link.
ci-bot: build/examples -> failed (flake8 lint) -> user patch applied -> retriggering.
ben-eng: ran locally, py and ts examples pass. go snippet triggered a race until i used Clone() as shown; suggested adding a comment about concurrency safety. pushed a small suggestion to the branch.
alex.docs: incorporated ben's suggestion. thank you. will open a backport PR to release-0.9.x after merge.
rachel-sdk: yes please backport and add a single-line changelog note: "examples: clarified streaming & pagination patterns and retry behavior (py/ts/go)".
alex.docs: will open backport + changelog entry. merging once CI green. :shipit:
